letter.text: I wake up with a letter in my hand.
The handwriting is mine. I don't remember writing it.

Trust Dov.
You won't remember why.

At the Records Office I saw the Ledger. Next: Dov's name.
Written before nightfall. — R.

meet_dov.text: Morning. The rain hasn't stopped since the Hush.

meet_dov.speaker: Dov
meet_dov.text: Rhea! Thank the lanterns. You're all right.

meet_dov.speaker: Dov
meet_dov.text: You do. Since last night, you just can't remember him.

meet_dov.speaker: Rhea
meet_dov.text: That's what every liar in Veyra says to a courier.
A calico cat darts out of the alley, past Rhea, and leaps into the stranger's arms.

meet_dov.speaker: Dov
meet_dov.text: Nala. Hey, girl. You still know me, don't you?

meet_dov.speaker: Rhea
meet_dov.text: She's never let anyone hold her. Not even me.

meet_dov.speaker: Dov
meet_dov.text: Animals don't live in the Reliquary. It can't take me from her.

meet_dov.speaker: Rhea
meet_dov.text: ...The letter said to trust you. Fine. I'll trust her.
Grey raincoats in the fog. Smooth faces, no eyes. Blanks.
Behind them, grey dust gathers into something with claws. A Hollow.

meet_dov.speaker: Dov
meet_dov.text: Behind me. They go for whoever's still holding on to something.

after_b1.speaker: Rhea
after_b1.text: What did you mean... they took you last night?

after_b1.speaker: Dov
after_b1.text: Every night the King takes one of us. Last night it was me. Everyone I knew forgot me.

after_b1.speaker: Rhea
after_b1.text: My letter says I saw the Ledger at the Records Office. Your name was on it.

after_b1.speaker: Dov
after_b1.text: The Ledger lists who goes next. If we steal it before tonight...

after_b1.speaker: Rhea
after_b1.text: ...nobody else wakes up a stranger to their own family.

after_b1.speaker: Dov
after_b1.text: The Records Office, then. Nala, stay close.
Halfway there, Nala's fur stands on end. The dust is gathering again.

records_office.text: The Records Office. Shelves to the ceiling, every drawer full of names.

records_office.speaker: The Clerk
records_office.text: A courier. Again. You were here yesterday, weren't you?

records_office.speaker: Rhea
records_office.text: I don't remember. You'd know why.

records_office.speaker: The Clerk
records_office.text: I used to be the royal archivist. Now nobody knows my name. Not even the ones I served.

records_office.speaker: The Clerk
records_office.text: His Majesty promised me that when the Ledger is done, I will be remembered again.

records_office.speaker: Dov
records_office.text: Give us the book, and no one else has to go through this.

records_office.speaker: The Clerk
records_office.text: And who are you? ...Ah. Of course. You're no one. Filed and forgotten.

keepsake_burn.speaker: Rhea
keepsake_burn.text: I can't beat him like this. I need more Echo.
A Keepsake: a memory held back for the end. Rhea has only one left.
Today. A stranger in the rain. A cat running to him. His voice saying her name.

keepsake_burn.speaker: Dov
keepsake_burn.text: Rhea, don't. That's the only part of me you have left.

keepsake_burn.speaker: Rhea
keepsake_burn.text: Then remember it for both of us.
She burns it. Her Echo floods back.

ending.speaker: The Clerk
ending.text: No... I was so close. They were going to remember me...
The Ledger falls open. Tonight's name is still unwritten.

ending.speaker: Rhea
ending.text: We did it. We have the Ledger.
She turns to the man beside her. Tall, worn jacket, bandaged fists.
Somewhere above the city, a silhouette watches from the broken tower.

archive_insight.speaker: Rhea
archive_insight.text: He pulled back inside that book... and we couldn't touch him.

archive_insight.speaker: Dov
archive_insight.text: Every blow we landed came back as his.

archive_insight.speaker: Rhea
archive_insight.text: Then we don't let him sit in there. Hit him until he staggers. Hard and fast.
